description: Hubble Money is a modern SaaS platform for channel incentives, loyalty, and rewards. It helps businesses launch a rewards store in ~24 hours at zero cost/low tech bandwidth via no-code/white-label solutions that drop into an app via SDK, integrate via a modern Rewards API, or run as a fully white-labeled web loyalty portal with no product integration. Hubble provides a catalogue of gift cards and rewards from 500+ brands (and reports 1,000+ merchants) across 20+ categories with exclusive discounts, configurable UI/templates, internal currency/coin integration, instant reward delivery (email/WhatsApp/SMS), fraud prevention, reconciliation, customer support, and analytics/real-time insights. Reported scale includes 100+ happy clients, 10L+ recipients, ₹1,000Cr+ GMV rewards processed, ₹500M+ rewards shared, and 40M+ users benefitted.
